title: Apple & Customs STOLE my batteries, that they won't even provide to AASPs.
summary: Louis Rossmann describes US Customs seizing replacement MacBook batteries at Apple's behest, while Apple refuses to supply the batteries to authorized service providers. It is part of his right-to-repair advocacy.
why: Cited in repair threads as evidence of Apple working with customs to restrict third-party repair parts.

quote.text: tactics like Rossmann described here: where US Customs is seizing imports of genuine Apple parts
